question: auto generate captions for video premiere pro
response_text:
As a content creator in the US looking to streamline your workflow for video premieres, automating captions in Adobe Premiere Pro—and leveraging external AI tools—is one of the best ways to boost viewer retention (especially since a huge percentage of social and platform video is consumed on mobile with the sound off). 

Here is a comprehensive guide to the best software tools, workflow methods, and industry-leading options tailored to your needs.

### 1. Key Industry Options & Software Tools

    *   *Best for:* Seamless, in-timeline editing without exporting files.
    *   *Why use it:* Adobe’s built-in AI (powered by Adobe Sensei) generates transcripts directly from your timeline audio with high accuracy
